reference_python:
import heapq
z=list(map(int,open(0).read().split()));n,m=z[:2];g=[[] for _ in range(n)];d=[0]*n
for i in range(m):u,v=z[2+2*i:4+2*i];g[u].append(v);d[v]+=1
q=[i for i in range(n) if d[i]==0];heapq.heapify(q);o=[]
while q:
 u=heapq.heappop(q);o.append(u)
 for v in g[u]:d[v]-=1
 if d[v]==0:heapq.heappush(q,v)
print(*o if len(o)==n else ['IMPOSSIBLE'])
